scenarioSurface.scenarioName: Preserve declared lifecycle transitions for projection

input.text: an admitted lifecycle graph and its state, operation, availability, and feedback references

outcome.text: each state, transition, cause, patch, dependent refresh, and lineage fact is preserved without inventing timing, concurrency, or execution behavior

scenarioSurface.notes:
Presentation lifecycle exposes declared idle, busy, cancelling, completed,
  cancelled, and failed facts and their permitted transitions. Projection must
  preserve lifecycle identities, transition causes, state patches, command
  refresh obligations, and feedback relationships without owning an operation.

providerQualification: Bindings are declared suppliers, not proof of live availability. Simulation requires explicit fixture/provider evidence.
